subject: Emotions
title: Emotional Manipulation
description: Learn Emotional Manipulation in one minute.

hook.text: A con artist reads his victim's loneliness perfectly and mirrors it. EQ isn't always used for good.

buildup.text: High EQ means reading emotions well. But that skill can serve manipulation as easily as connection.

discovery.text: Adam Grant calls this 'the dark side of EQ': people who weaponize emotional perception to control others.

twist.text: Studies show Machiavellian personalities score high on EQ tests. They read emotions perfectly—then exploit them.

climax.text: EQ without ethics is a tool for con artists, cult leaders, and abusers. Skill without values is dangerous.

punchline.text: EQ is a tool. The hand that holds it decides whether it heals or harms.

quiz.question: Who discusses the 'dark side' of emotional intelligence?
